security_concerns.issue: Arbitrary signed/auth-bearing source URLs and thumbnail queries can reach durable download_jobs columns.
security_concerns.required_fix: Validate canonical supported public source IDs before enqueue and discard unsafe durable thumbnail URLs; regression tests.

logic_errors.issue: Publication and queue completion are separate commits; recovery/retry can duplicate already-published audio.
logic_errors.required_fix: Durable publication association/reconciliation, shared Room transaction for track insertion and completion, optional artwork after completion, crash-boundary tests.

logic_errors.issue: Activity-captured delete callback skips queue reconciliation after rotation/disconnection.
logic_errors.required_fix: Retained explicit deletion IDs reconciled with current controller; delayed-delete/recreation tests. Do not infer deletion from transient empty library.

logic_errors.issue: Playback error clears selected Preview context, hiding failed/Retry surface.
logic_errors.required_fix: Invalidate stream cache, stop playback, preserve selected hit in failed state and retry fresh; preserve cleanup exclusion.

suggestions: Bound overall artwork download duration, not only read timeout and bytes.
Document MediaMetadataRetriever embeddedPicture allocation before byte cap.
Retain explicit physical-device acceptance gates for MediaStore, migration, background behavior, cancellation, clipping and visual layout.
summary: Blocked pending focused fixes and independent re-review. Host checks passed, not physical Android execution.
